$comment: The inputs the status decision table reads. Not a JSON Schema: it is the table tools/status.mjs consults, and the table tools/validate-schemas.mjs checks for drift against the enums. Every coverageSkipReason must be classified here, so adding a skip reason forces a decision about whether it reduces coverage.

blockingRule.$comment: A finding blocks only when it is BOTH critical and deterministic. Probabilistic findings never block on their own: §7.3 forbids presenting ambiguous categories as facts without user review, and §17.1 requires zero clean control files to be assigned a blocking deterministic finding. A probabilistic critical finding is still shown, still severe, and still reaches the user — it just does not let the product assert, as fact, that sharing must stop.

not_applicable_to_media_type.rationale: The detector correctly did not apply. A PNG has no EXIF block; reporting that as incomplete coverage would make every clean image partial and train users to ignore the state.

disabled_by_user.rationale: The user chose not to run it, but the check still did not happen. §5.3 forbids silent safety claims, so the result may not present itself as complete.

blocked_by_encryption.rationale: Content exists that could not be read.

input_too_large.rationale: Content exists that was not read.

dependency_unavailable.rationale: The check could have run and did not.

cancelled.rationale: The user stopped the run. §12.1 additionally requires that cancellation never leave something that looks successfully processed.
